sentences.en: We finally decided to give him over to the police.
sentences.zh: 我们最终决定把他交给警方。

sentences.en: The police came as soon as they heard the gunfire.
sentences.zh: 听到枪声后，警察很快就到了。

sentences.en: He ran away at the sight of a police patrol.
sentences.zh: 一看到警察巡逻队他就逃走了。

senses.zh: 监督；管辖；维持治安；为…配备警察
